settings.label: Server Address
settings.help: Your Emby or Jellyfin server, such as http://192.168.1.2:8096. Just the host also works: port 8096 is assumed.

settings.label: API Key
settings.help: Made in the server's dashboard: Advanced > API Keys in Emby, API Keys in Jellyfin. With a key, the user name below says whose library to use, and the password isn't needed. Leave it empty to sign in with a user name and password.

settings.label: User Name
settings.help: Your user on the server. With an API key and no user name, the server's administrator is used.

settings.label: Password
settings.help: Your password, for signing in without an API key. Empty for a user without one.
